subject: maths
question: A certain sum amounts to ₹8,094 at 10.5% p.a. in 4 years, at simple interest. What will be the amount (in ₹) of the same sum at the same rate in 6{ {2} over 3}years, at simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount = ₹8,094

Rate = 10.5% p.a.

Time = 4 years

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

Amount = P + S.I

Here,

P = Sum

T = Time

R = Rate

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be P

Now,

P + (P × 4 × 10.5)/100 = 8094

⇒ (100P + 42P)/100 = 8094
